description:
Manage X/Twitter Communities as a connected account: join or leave an existing community, or delete a community you own. (X no longer allows creating new Communities.)

Guidance: PREREQUISITE: connect an X account. Acts as a handle THIS wallet owns. action=join|leave (community_id) | delete (community_id + community_name confirmation). action=create is refused: X no longer allows new Communities. account required. Payment settles before the action; Idempotency-Key required.

account.description: A connected X handle owned by this wallet (no @).

community_name.description: delete: the community name, as confirmation.

name: x_community
